description: An Angular 18 standalone app built with the SEALED @angular-devkit/build-angular:application (esbuild) builder, then obfuscated by @afterpack/angular's afterpackAngular() postbuild helper over dist/<app>/browser -- the canonical Angular path (the modern builder exposes no plugin hook). The helper auto-locates the browser output (findAngularBrowserDir), so this fixture is what exercises that published code against real `ng build` output. The app is a small notes app: Angular Router navigation; a counter button that is an attribute-selector child component taking @Input()s, catching its own click with @HostListener and emitting an @Output() to its parent; a ReactiveFormsModule FormGroup from a constructor-injected FormBuilder with Validators.required, Validators.minLength and Validators.maxLength; the saved notes rendered by a component declared in an @NgModule that the standalone notes route imports; a root-provided signal store, read through inject(), that persists notes to localStorage through an effect; and a loadComponent route whose report reads the notes through a class with private fields and getters and formats them with a pure custom pipe.

build.note: build.mjs runs `ng build --configuration production` then calls afterpackAngular({ cwd, seed, protectionMap: true }) -- no browserDir, so findAngularBrowserDir locates dist/angular-fixture/browser itself, and the combined Protection Map lands in the gitignored .afterpack/; honors AFTERPACK_build_autorun=false for the un-obfuscated baseline, which AFTERPACK_E2E_DIST_DIR=dist-baseline builds beside it

interactions.description: Clicking the counter runs the obfuscated Angular signal update and re-renders.
